title: Regional Dust Storm Inbound
narrative: A high-altitude dust plume sweeps across the plains. Atmospheric opacity (tau) jumps, filtering incoming sunlight.

choices.label: Deploy electrostatic dust wipers and tilt arrays
choices.lesson: Active dust mitigation maintains 55% power, but draws continuous actuator energy.

choices.label: Battern down arrays and accept reduced solar output
choices.lesson: Without specialized cleaning equipment, dust accumulation chokes solar arrays by 70%.

title: Planet-Encircling Dust Event
narrative: Orbital telemetry confirms planet-wide storm consolidation. Sun-blocking dust will blot out 90% of sunlight for weeks.

choices.label: Power down greenhouse and rely on fission baseload
choices.lesson: Nuclear fission is impervious to dust, keeping base life support safe despite severe gloom.

choices.label: Emergency grid shedding: draw reserves and cut heaters
choices.lesson: Solar-dependent outposts face catastrophic brownouts when planet-wide storms strike Mars.

title: Solar Particle Event Inbound
narrative: A coronal mass ejection releases a torrent of relativistic protons heading directly for the outpost.

choices.label: Retreat crew into the water-jacket storm shelter
choices.lesson: Dense hydrogen in water walls absorbs primary protons, slashing acute radiation dosage.

choices.label: Hunker in central hab corridor and divert power to active coils
choices.lesson: Without a dedicated storm shelter, unshielded hab walls allow significant solar proton penetration.

title: Primary ECLSS Water Loop Seized
narrative: Cavitation in the primary water recycling centrifuge has seized the bearing, halting graywater purification.

choices.label: Swap in precision spare impeller and rebuild seal
choices.lesson: Having spare parts allows immediate repair before life-support reserves drain.

choices.label: Bypass recycler and consume unrecoverable emergency water
choices.lesson: Without spares, equipment faults force rapid depletion of unrecoverable tank storage.

title: Hydroponic Nutrient Fungus Outbreak
narrative: Spore contamination in the root chambers threatens to wipe out the current potato and leafy green harvest.

choices.label: Synthesize anti-fungal wash and prune infected trays
choices.lesson: Medical reagents salvage the crop colony at the cost of water flushing.

choices.label: Incinerate half the greenhouse trays to quarantine the rest
choices.lesson: Crop failures instantly throw the colony back onto limited pre-packaged rations.

title: Battery Thermal Runaway Alarm
narrative: Sub-zero cold creeping past insulation has caused internal cell resistance to spike, threatening catastrophic shorts.

choices.label: Re-route around damaged cell block using spare connectors
choices.lesson: Isolating bad battery banks avoids fires while preserving 85% of storage capacity.

choices.label: Dump charge into exterior heat dump to prevent explosion
choices.lesson: Dumping stored energy eliminates fire risk but leaves nighttime habitat power precarious.

title: Kilopower Secondary Loop Pressure Drop
narrative: Telemetry flags sodium-potassium trace leak in the Stirling engine radiator boom outside the habitat.

choices.label: Dispatch rover with spare alloy patch kit to seal radiator
choices.lesson: Complex fission engines require active maintenance to preserve uninterrupted output.

choices.label: Throttle reactor core to 50% power to lower loop pressure
choices.lesson: Throttling a fission reactor halves energy generation during critical operations.

title: Martian Aphelion Cold Snap
narrative: Surface temperature plunges to -115°C. Habitat hull heat loss spikes, demanding massive electrical thermal support.

choices.label: Lean on regolith berm insulation and cycle internal blowers
choices.lesson: Regolith is not just a radiation shield; its thermal mass stabilizes habitat temperature.

choices.label: Run electrical heaters at maximum output to protect hull seals
choices.lesson: Uninsulated surface habitats consume extreme power just to stay above freezing.

title: Airlock Perchlorate Ingress
narrative: Fine electrostatically charged Martian soil containing toxic perchlorates breached outer suit vacuum brushes.

choices.label: Administer thyroid blockers and flush air scrubber cartridges
choices.lesson: Medical countermeasures neutralize toxic Martian soil exposure before thyroid harm occurs.

choices.label: Lock down living quarters and vent airlock volume
choices.lesson: Venting contaminated air bleeds valuable oxygen stores into the thin Martian atmosphere.

title: Solar Conjunction Comms Blackout
narrative: The Sun passes directly between Earth and Mars, scrambling radio transmission for two full weeks.

choices.label: Implement autonomous crew schedule with recreation rotations
choices.lesson: Crew morale facilities alleviate isolation anxiety when Earth contact is impossible.

choices.label: Enforce high-stress emergency drills and tight rationing
choices.lesson: Isolation compounds psychological strain when crew members lack relaxation outlets.

title: Hydroponic Super-Harvest
narrative: Optimal LED spectrum calibration produced an unexpected bumper crop of fast-growing microgreens and radishes.

choices.label: Host a feast for the crew to celebrate the milestone
choices.lesson: Fresh food provides massive psychological and nutritional boosts in deep space.

choices.label: Dehydrate and vacuum-seal surplus calories into emergency rations
choices.lesson: Preserving surplus food requires electrical drying energy but extends survival margins.

title: Emergency Trans-Mars Injection Offer
narrative: NASA offers to expedite an autonomous cargo trajectory carrying emergency consumables to Mars.

choices.label: Guide incoming payload via radar transponder (incurs score penalty)
choices.lesson: Accepting emergency resupply saves lives but demonstrates failure of self-sufficiency.

choices.label: Decline drop and trust existing outpost equipment
choices.lesson: Declining external aid validates engineering autonomy, boosting team pride.
